objectives.sourceGoalText: tell them your child is sick and will stay home today

title.es: Avisar de que tu hijo está enfermo y se queda hoy en casa
title.en: Tell them your child is sick and will stay home today
title.it: Comunicare che tuo figlio è malato e oggi resta a casa
title.tr: Çocuğunun hasta olduğunu ve bugün evde kalacağını bildirmek
title.ar: إبلاغهم بأن طفلك مريض وسيبقى في المنزل اليوم
title.uk: Повідомити, що дитина захворіла і сьогодні залишиться вдома

requiredCriteria.observation: learner makes clear that the child will not come today
learner explains that the child is ill
learner takes up the acknowledgement or the next step the kindergarten states

optionalCriteria.observation: learner closes the exchange appropriately for the channel

objectives.sourceGoalText: ask about the schedule for the summer party and what to bring

title.es: Preguntar por el horario de la fiesta de verano y qué hay que llevar
title.en: Ask about the schedule for the summer party and what to bring
title.it: Chiedere il programma della festa d'estate e cosa portare
title.tr: Yaz şenliğinin programını ve ne getirilmesi gerektiğini sormak
title.ar: السؤال عن برنامج حفلة الصيف وما الذي يجب إحضاره
title.uk: Запитати про розклад літнього свята і що потрібно принести

requiredCriteria.observation: learner asks about the time or programme of the summer party
learner responds consistently with the connected arrangements given

optionalCriteria.observation: learner confirms or checks the agreed detail before the exchange ends

objectives.sourceGoalText: tell them the grandmother will pick up the child today

title.es: Avisar de que hoy recoge al niño la abuela
title.en: Tell them the grandmother will pick up the child today
title.it: Avvisare che oggi il bambino lo prende la nonna
title.ar: إبلاغهم بأن الجدة ستأخذ الطفل اليوم
title.uk: Повідомити, що сьогодні дитину забере бабуся

requiredCriteria.observation: learner makes clear that someone else will collect the child today
learner identifies the person who will collect the child
learner confirms or checks that the change has been understood

optionalCriteria.observation: learner closes the exchange appropriately for the channel
